Records.authors: Chestnov, Vsevolod, Crisanti, Giulio, Giroux, Mathieu
Records.description: Fully massive envelope: tetrahedral (K4) graph on 4 vertices, 6 internal propagators of mass m1, and 4 external legs of a DISTINCT mass M1 (fully massive, on-shell, p_i^2=M1^2) -- a 3-loop, 4-point 'bottleneck' diagram (computed as L = E - V + 1 = 6 - 4 + 1 = 3 from the graph below; the paper's caption states the loop order explicitly only for (b,c), not (a)). The paper reports 8 new Landau singularities found relative to the reference dataset of Fevola-Mizera-Telen (PLDdata), the largest of length 653 and total degree 21. EDGE LIST, VERTEX LABELS AND MASSES WERE SUPPLIED DIRECTLY BY THE USER, NOT EXTRACTED FROM PAPER TEXT: the arXiv LaTeX source shows this diagram only as a PDF figure (figures/diagram_envelope.pdf) with a descriptive caption -- no propagator/graph data appears in the paper's text. The full singularity list is stated to live in the paper's companion repository (\githubrepo), not in the arXiv source.
